name: Bonanza Billion

features.name: Pay-anywhere refills
features.description: Symbols pay anywhere and the reels refill after wins.

features.name: Free spins
features.description: 4/5/6 scatters award 10/20/30 free spins; three scatters add five more.

features.name: Summed multipliers
features.description: 2x–100x multipliers in the bonus are added together for each refill sequence.

review:
Where BGaming's Bonanza series started: a fruity pay-anywhere game where it's the number of matching symbols on screen that pays. Winners clear, the reels refill, and wins can chain.

Four, five or six scatters give 10, 20 or 30 free spins, with five more for three scatters in the round. Multipliers from 2x to 100x only show up in free spins and add together at the end of each sequence. 15,000x max and a 95.97% RTP. The bonus is rare – about once every 395 spins – so it's one for patient players.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus is rare (about 1 in 395 spins on average)
Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
